results.question: How many days of paid annual leave do employees get?
results.answer: Employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. [1] Unused leave of up to 5 days can be carried over to the next year. [1]

results.question: What is the probation period for new employees?
results.answer: The probation period for new employees is 6 months. [1] Employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. [1]

results.question: Which agents does SAARTH use?
results.answer: SAARTH uses five agents orchestrated with LangGraph: a planner, a tool agent, a retriever, a writer and a critic. [1] SAARTH is a retrieval-augmented, multi-agent AI assistant. [1]

results.question: How large are the document chunks?
results.answer: Documents are split into overlapping chunks of 800 characters with an overlap of 120 characters. [1]
